ideaContract.purpose: Make the NEO REZONANS repositories behave as one inspectable trust system while preserving distinct roles for intent, memory, causal navigation, authorization, verification, proof, persistence, and reinterpretation.
ideaContract.expectedOutcome: Every system layer is pinned to canonical main and every cross-repository boundary declares what can be transferred and what must never be inferred.
invariants: default dependencies are canonical rather than branch-only
FCRP PASS never silently becomes mutation permission
provenance and semantic compatibility remain separable
forbiddenOutcomes: ambient dependency on proposed or experimental branch state
implicit execution authority crossing a non-authority edge
repository drift silently preserving a stale whole-system claim
ideaContract.parentContract: Human-governed NEO REZONANS architecture: understand and verify broadly, but transfer execution authority only through an explicit authorization contract.

evidence.claim: The system snapshot pins canonical layer revisions and declares allowed facts, forbidden inferences, one explicit authority edge, and one reflection feedback edge.
RESONANCE canonical main contains the FCRP origin document and implementation update used as the intent/observatory layer for this snapshot.
CML canonical main contains the current applicability/information-quality recovery boundary from SELF-006.
LiminalOSAI canonical main contains SELF-009, making review evidence explicitly non-authorizing across repository boundaries.
ContractGraph-QA canonical main contains FCRP v0.2 and the deterministic state-transition verification surfaces consumed by this system snapshot.
ProofPath canonical main contains SELF-005 capability canonicality governance and canonical SCIG v0.1.
LiminalDB canonical main contains the reconciled provenance/compatibility contract and Pythia verified-negative child validation layer.
RINSE canonical main contains one shared reflection semantics plus the SELF-008 Career domain projection boundary.

past.summary: The architecture existed conceptually while individual capabilities were split across canonical main, stacked branches, historical contracts, and domain-specific semantic surfaces.

present.summary: SELF-005 through SELF-009 and FCRP v0.2 are promoted, and the participating repositories now expose canonical revisions that can be pinned into one bounded system snapshot.

future.summary: Any canonical main drift triggers an explicit system-snapshot revalidation instead of silently inheriting new semantics across repository boundaries.

causalPath.statement: The repositories had strong local contracts but no shared machine-readable statement of exact canonical revisions and cross-repository transfer semantics.
A consumer could correctly identify a local capability yet still infer stale canonicality, authority, compatibility, or semantic meaning when composing repositories.
Pin one canonical system snapshot and declare allowed facts, forbidden inferences, explicit authority mode, and feedback semantics on every repository edge.
The bounded snapshot can be structurally validated and its pinned revisions checked against the actual repository main heads before acceptance.

navigation.reason: The remaining ambiguity was above every individual repository: the missing contract belonged to the system composition layer.

refactor.change: Introduce a canonical point-in-time NEO REZONANS system snapshot with exact repository identities and explicit transfer/non-transfer semantics.
refactor.expectedEffect: Cross-repository composition becomes inspectable and fail-closed against branch drift, authority inference, provenance/compatibility conflation, and parallel semantic authority.

authorization.authorityBoundary: FCRP-SYSTEM-001 validates a system composition snapshot only. It does not authorize repository writes, deployments, financial actions, or external-system mutations.
